application_gates: Fixed installed routing only; no flex-life or moving corner qualification.
Supplier describes nominal dimensions; bend and clamp fits need measured maximum OD and tolerances.
Silicone mechanical protection, vibration, clamp liner and moisture environment unqualified.
Black positive cable requires durable positive identification.
Crimp contacts, lug strip length and tooling are not qualified.
Catalogue voltage value does not establish system certification or protection coordination.

scenario.current_limit_status: Proposed warm-bank development cap; enforcement absent. This value is not cable ampacity approval.
scenario.model: R = rho20 * (positive centreline length + negative centreline length) / 70 mm²; voltage drop = I*R; heat = I²*R.
scenario.rho20_status: Declared ideal-copper modelling assumption; not the maximum conductor resistance of this tinned stranded SKU.
